contribution.position: I hold my earlier position on the reliability axis: the change is not ready. I am answering qa, who claims risk is contained because artifact:perf-report shows a 0.4% error_rate inside the 1% budget. That figure does not appear in the artifact list: artifact:perf-report actually states error_rate measured 3.4% at peak load against a 1% budget, so qa's anchor contradicts the cited datum — that gap needs to be named, not smoothed over. New evidence I did not cite before reinforces this: artifact:incident-log records two sev2 incidents last quarter, both traced to retry storms, which is precisely the load-amplified failure mode a 3.4x peak-load error-rate overshoot invites. The clean test report (artifact:test-report, 412 passed, 87% coverage) does not capture peak-load behavior, so the only reliability-relevant measurements we have — the perf report and the incident history — both point against readiness.
